en.asce_desc: Calculate wind, snow, and rain loads according to ASCE 7 standards. Generate load combinations for structural design.
en.aisc_desc: Check steel members and connections based on the AISC Steel Construction Manual. Includes member checks, base plates, and splices.
en.base_plate_desc: Design and check column base plates and anchor bolts for combined axial load and biaxial bending according to AISC Design Guide 1.
en.splice_desc: Design and check bolted flange plate and web plate splices for wide-flange members under moment and shear.
en.nds_desc: Design and check wood members for bending, shear, and compression according to the National Design Specification for Wood Construction.
en.aci_desc: Check reinforced concrete beams for flexure and shear based on ACI 318 building code requirements.
en.nbr_combos_desc: Generate ultimate (ELU) and serviceability (ELS) load combinations based on NBR 8681 and NBR 6118.
en.nbr_concrete_desc: Check reinforced concrete beams for flexure and shear according to Brazilian standard NBR 6118.
en.nbr_prestressed_desc: Analyze prestressed concrete beams, including detailed calculations for prestressing losses over time.
en.nbr_wood_desc: Check wood members for bending and shear according to Brazilian standard NBR 7190.
en.nbr_steel_desc: Check steel members for combined axial force and bending according to Brazilian standard NBR 8800.
en.aci_318_about_desc: This calculator checks a rectangular reinforced concrete beam for flexure and shear based on the provisions of ACI 318-19. It determines the nominal moment and shear capacity and compares it to the factored loads.
en.mn_desc: Generate the N-M interaction diagram for reinforced concrete sections (Rectangular, T, I) according to NBR 6118.
en.beam_selector_desc: Finds the lightest W-shape based on Unbraced Length (Lb) and Required Moment (Mu). Calculates capacities per AISC 360-16/22 Chapter F.
en.angle_support_desc: Design and check steel angle supports for various loading conditions.
en.angle_support_subtitle: Checks masonry anchors for a single angle beam support using linear interaction.
en.trib_width_desc: Width of deck supported by this beam.

en.beam_selector_desc_long: Finds the lightest W-shape based on Unbraced Length (Lb) and Required Moment (Mu). Calculates capacities per AISC 360-16/22 Chapter F.

en.eq_exponents_desc: Adjust the exponents on the formulation to see real-time effects on the shear capacity distribution.
en.opt_hint_cov: Auto-minimizes CoV targeted to the Safety Margin.
en.opt_hint_locked: Coefficients marked with Locked remain fixed during fit.

en.lock_tooltip_free: Click to lock this coefficient at current value during fit
en.param_c_desc: Scale calibration factor adjusting global mean safety level.
en.param_alpha_desc: Size Effect exponent: models shear strength decay in large depth members (d).
en.param_beta_desc: Longitudinal steel ratio exponent: governs dowel action and crack width control.
en.param_gamma_desc: Concrete strength exponent: contributes through tensile strength and uncracked compression zone.
en.param_delta_desc: Shear span ratio (a/d - length analysis): accounts for direct strut / arch action when a/d < 2.5 vs beam action for a/d >= 2.5.
en.param_epsilon_desc: Web width exponent: directly scales nominal shear capacity with section width bw.
en.param_zeta_desc: Effective depth exponent: geometric depth scaling for total resisting shear force.
en.guide_subtitle: Fundamental physical phenomena governing concrete shear capacity without stirrups
en.guide_size_effect_desc: Larger members (d > 600mm) fail at significantly lower average shear stresses due to wider critical crack openings, which reduce aggregate interlock. The factor (d_dg / d)^α counteracts this by accounting for aggregate roughness.
en.guide_shear_span_desc: The a/d ratio represents the length analysis of the shear span relative to effective depth. When a/d < 2.5 (short span), load is transferred directly to supports via an inclined compressive strut (arch action / biela direta), resulting in much higher capacity. For a/d >= 2.5 (long span), standard beam flexure-shear action governs.
en.guide_reinforcement_title: Longitudinal Reinforcement (Taxa de Armadura ρw - β)
en.guide_reinforcement_desc: Longitudinal reinforcement provides dowel action across the diagonal crack and restrains crack opening, preserving friction and aggregate interlock.
en.guide_fck_desc: Shear failure is brittle and governed by tensile strength fct, which scales with fck^(1/3) or fck^(1/2), as well as the strength of the intact compressive zone.
en.guide_geometry_desc: The geometric product bw^ε · d^ζ converts nominal shear stress into resisting shear force. Typically ε ≈ 1.0 and ζ ≈ 1.0 (shear area bw · d).
en.guide_stats_desc: R = V_test / V_calc represents model safety (R ≥ 1.0 is safe). The Coefficient of Variation (CoV = σ / μ) measures dispersion against 1804 empirical beam tests from Reineck database. A lower CoV indicates superior prediction accuracy.
en.all_locked_alert: All coefficients are locked! Unlock at least one coefficient (🔓) so the algorithm can optimize it.
en.reset_confirm: Reset all coefficients and selections back to Reineck baseline defaults?
en.chart_legend_title: Interactive Chart Legend (Click items to toggle visibility)

es.param_c_desc: Factor de escala de calibración que ajusta el nivel medio global de seguridad.
es.param_alpha_desc: Efecto de Escala: modela la pérdida de resistencia a cortante en piezas de gran canto útil (d).
es.param_beta_desc: Cuantía longitudinal: gobierna el efecto pasador (dowel action) y control de fisuración.
es.param_gamma_desc: Resistencia del hormigón: contribuye mediante tracción y zona comprimida intacta.
es.param_delta_desc: Relación vano/canto (a/d - análisis de longitud): refleja el mecanismo de biela directa / arco para a/d < 2.5 frente a mecanismo de viga para a/d >= 2.5.
es.param_epsilon_desc: Ancho del alma: escala directamente la capacidad nominal con el ancho bw.
es.param_zeta_desc: Canto útil: factor geométrico de profundidad para la fuerza cortante resistente total.
es.guide_title: Guía de Parámetros y Mecánica de Cortante
es.guide_subtitle: Fenómenos físicos fundamentales que gobiernan la resistencia a cortante de elementos sin estribos
es.guide_size_effect_desc: Piezas de mayor canto (d > 600mm) fallan a tensiones medias de cortante sensiblemente menores debido a mayor apertura de fisura crítica, reduciendo el trabado de áridos. El término (d_dg / d)^α modela la rugosidad del árido.
es.guide_shear_span_title: Análisis de Longitud y Vano de Cortante (a/d - δ)
es.guide_shear_span_desc: La relación a/d representa el análisis de longitud del vano de cortante respecto al canto útil. Para a/d < 2.5 (vano corto), la carga se transmite directamente a apoyos por biela comprimida inclinada (efecto arco / biela directa), elevando la resistencia. Para a/d >= 2.5 (vano largo), predomina el mecanismo de viga.
es.guide_reinforcement_desc: La armadura longitudinal actúa por efecto pasador (dowel action) y restringe la apertura de fisura diagonal, preservando la fricción y trabado de áridos.
es.guide_fck_desc: La rotura por cortante es frágil y gobernada por la resistencia a tracción fct (proporcional a fck^(1/3) o fck^(1/2)) y la zona comprimida intacta.
es.guide_geometry_desc: El producto geométrico bw^ε · d^ζ convierte la tensión nominal resistente en fuerza cortante nominal resistente. Típicamente ε ≈ 1.0 y ζ ≈ 1.0 (área de cortante bw · d).
es.guide_stats_title: Evaluación Estadística: Margen de Seguridad (R) y Dispersión (CoV)
es.guide_stats_desc: R = V_test / V_calc mide la seguridad (R ≥ 1.0 es seguro). El Coeficiente de Variación (CoV = σ / μ) cuantifica la dispersión frente a 1804 ensayos reales de Reineck. Menor CoV indica mayor precisión y consistencia.

pt.guide_title: Guia dos Parâmetros & Mecânica do Cisalhamento
pt.guide_subtitle: Fenómenos físicos fundamentais que governam a resistência ao cisalhamento de elementos sem estribos
pt.guide_size_effect_desc: Peças de maior espessura (d > 600mm) rompem com tensões médias de cisalhamento sensivelmente menores devido à maior abertura da fissura crítica, que reduz o engrenamento de agregados. O termo (d_dg / d)^α modela a rugosidade do agregado.
pt.guide_shear_span_title: Análise de Comprimento & Vão de Cisalhamento (a/d - δ)
pt.guide_shear_span_desc: A relação a/d representa a análise de comprimento do vão de cisalhamento em relação à altura útil. Para a/d < 2.5 (vão curto), a carga é transmitida diretamente aos apoios por uma biela comprimida inclinada (efeito arco / biela direta), elevando substancialmente a capacidade resistente. Para a/d >= 2.5 (vão longo), predomina o mecanismo de flexão-cisalhamento de viga.
pt.guide_reinforcement_desc: A armadura longitudinal atua por efeito pino (dowel action) e restringe a abertura da fissura diagonal, preservando o atrito e engrenamento de agregados.
pt.guide_fck_desc: A ruptura por cisalhamento é frágil e governada pela resistência à tração fct (proporcional a fck^(1/3) ou fck^(1/2)) e pela zona comprimida superior intacta.
pt.guide_geometry_desc: O produto geométrico bw^ε · d^ζ converte a tensão nominal resistente em força cortante nominal resistente. Tipicamente ε ≈ 1.0 e ζ ≈ 1.0 (área cisalhada bw · d).
pt.guide_stats_title: Avaliação Estatística: Margem de Segurança (R) & Dispersão (CoV)
pt.guide_stats_desc: R = V_test / V_calc mede a segurança (R ≥ 1.0 é seguro). O Coeficiente de Variação (CoV = σ / μ) quantifica a dispersão frente aos 1804 ensaios reais da base Reineck. Menor CoV indica maior precisão e consistência da fórmula.
